text_to_speech: tell me for your day we've had loads of support from members of the public we've had everyone from young kids uh workers like ourselves uh up to the elderly coming in and just offering their support and saying how good it is to see people taking action a lot of the kids are very interested to find out what's going on and a lot of the older people remember what it was like on the Thatcher and they don't want to see a repeat of it so that's fun today we have it's been brilliant aside from some of the pancakes so on this street how many picket lines Triads live in the house is the contact center for hmrc there's the job center DWP another hmrc site further up uh obviously there's a few beds at the top as well so yeah about six or seven in this office and the one bit further up is compliance so how many people have they been on the streets on the picket lines um it's varied we lost quite a few to the rally at midday first thing this morning we had about 30 on our line uh over a dozen okay um over a dozen on litherlands house similar sort of numbers going right so we had a lot of support from members of Salford and UK uncut this morning as well um so how many people are in today uh just over 20. out of the workforce of uh just over 900. so it's been really well supported today brilliant and your daughter's not in school not in school because her school is closed due to the strike action which is good well done moves teachers
